text_blocks.snippet: Burkholderia pseudomallei infection, also known as melioidosis, can cause a wide range of symptoms, often mimicking other illnesses, making diagnosis challenging. The most common presentation is pulmonary melioidosis, which can range from mild bronchitis to severe pneumonia. Symptoms include cough, chest pain, fever, and difficulty breathing. Other forms of melioidosis can cause skin sores, abscesses, and even septic shock.
